The '''Mark II Z3-NO landscaping droid''' was a model of [[gardener droid]]. One such droid was involved in the colonization of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
The Mark II Z3-NO was a [[gardener droid]] that was roughly shaped like a dome with several appendages. It was equipped with a vast array of tools, including compressors, [[Shovel/Legends|shovels]], grinders, hydrators, pulverizers and vaporators that allowed it to perform various tasks such as pulverizing rocks or dredging [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. It was used for [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. The droid was known to be quick and efficient, but it would [[Death/Legends|kill]] any creature or plant that was in its path. There existed at least one unit that was covered in [[Color/Legends|orange]] plating.<ref name="TGF" />

==History==
The Z3-NO line was created during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its initial target market was the wealthy land owners of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] who wanted to avoid the labor of gardening themselves. In the wake of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] launched a colonization effort on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. In order for that effort to be successful, a landscaping droid was required, and a Z3-NO unit was brought to Ohma-Dun.<ref name="TGF" />
